To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of insect oil, protein, and chitin in feed for poultry, pigs, and fish has a positive effect on growth and feed conversion, and that the use of chitin in feed can improve the quality of the meat and the eggs of the animals.
the use of the invention is to obtain an insect powder from the insects.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new insect processing methods, in particular methods that are suitable for the production of powders, which are suitable for the use of insects in the diet.
the development of an efficient method for the processing of insects into a powder, which can be used for the production of animal feed, in particular fish feed, as well as for human consumption.
the processing and use of insect powder as a protein source in animal nutrition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the invention relates to a process of processing insects, comprising the following steps: a) separating the cuticle of the soft part from the insects, b) separating the soft part into three fractions: i) an oil fraction ii) a solid fraction iii) an aqueous fraction.
the method of treating insects comprising separating the cuticles of soft part of the insect and the separation of soft part of insect into oil fraction, solids fraction and aqueous fraction.

the method according to the present invention provides a method for the processing of insects, in particular for the processing of soft part insects, comprising the separation of a soft cuticle of the insects, and the separation of a solid fraction and an aqueously fraction, wherein a liquid fraction is separated from the solid fraction and the aqueously fraction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new method to produce insect protein powder, which has a very high protein content and a very low fat content.
our work has led to the development of an insect processing method which can be used to separate insects into a solids fraction, an aqueous fraction and an oil fraction.
we are able to extract a powder from insect cuticles and this powder is a good source of protein and amino acid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the insect processing method of the present invention can be used for the production of insect powders that can be used as an ingredient in a diet.

the method of insect processing according to the invention can be used to separate the cuticles of insects and the soft part of insects, and to separate the soft part in an oil fraction, solids fraction and aqueous fraction.
the insect powder has a high nutritional value and can replace fishmeal in the diet, said the researcher, who is also the director of the Institute of Food Technology.
